open_points.subject: ProgressView availability when no SectionProgress exists
open_points.text: “A section without a record has no recorded progress: its views show `completion_percent = None` and `completed_work_value = None`” and ProgressView defines those nullable fields, but Read availability says “`not_configured` means the portal has no owning data yet,” while ProjectOverview requires `progress` to be absent unless `progress_availability = available`.
open_points.question: When an active budget has planned sections but none has a SectionProgress record, does reading progress return an available ProgressView containing those sections with `None` values, or `progress_availability = not_configured` with no ProgressView?
options: Return `available` with a ProgressView whose sections have `completion_percent = None` and `completed_work_value = None`, and whose completed-work total is the empty sum.
Return `not_configured` and omit ProgressView until the first SectionProgress record is created; the nullable values remain visible only in other projections such as BudgetView.
open_points.default_guess: Return `available` so the newly specified absence values are observable in the progress read.

witness.initial: Project P has an active budget containing section S with positive planned work, and no SectionProgress record exists for S or any other section.
events: A viewer with an active grant opens P's ProjectOverview.
outcomes: The overview reports `progress_availability = available` and includes a ProgressView with S, `completion_percent = None`, and `completed_work_value = None`.
The overview reports `progress_availability = not_configured` and `progress = None` because no owning SectionProgress data exists.
witness.observer: The viewer and any API client consuming ProjectOverview.
